verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents its own non-UI programmatic surface. The Query API returns the same results as web-app reports, the Import and Raw Export APIs move data server-side, Service Accounts are the recommended auth, and OpenAPI specs cover every API, so automated scripts can drive it without the dashboard. Nothing in the evidence documents a CLI, CI-specific guidance, or a headless runner, so CI use has to be assembled from raw API calls. missing for 10: official CLI or CI integration (e.g. GitHub Action), documented CI/automation workflows, hands-on corroboration of headless automation use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
